editorial:
Imagine trying to get a dead grandfather home for a funeral, but your car breaks down and you have to lug the body onto a train. That is the wild setup you get here. You will meet Lemi and Kiza, two guys who are just trying to do the right thing but are terrible at it. Then you have Limeni, a drug dealer who is dealing with his own set of problems. The vibe is pure chaos from the start. It feels like one of those days where everything that could possibly go wrong actually does, and you are just along for the ride as these weird characters collide in the most awkward ways possible.

What really makes this work is the funny chemistry between the leads and the way the tension builds up on the train. The pacing is quick, and the jokes land well because the situations are so ridiculous. While some of the plot twists feel a bit random, the energy keeps you interested. If you love dark comedies where normal people end up in crazy spots, you should definitely check this out. You can grab the 4K Blu-ray for your physical collection to see the details, or just rent it on Apple TV for a quick movie night with friends.
endingExplained: The chaos peaks when the drug deal and the dead body plot finally crash together. After a series of loud fights and misunderstandings on the train, the group manages to survive the madness. The movie wraps up by showing that despite all the crime and the dead relative, the characters end up in a place of weird peace. It ends on a funny note, proving that life is unpredictable and often completely absurd.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves dark comedies and crime mishaps.
